figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 1. Representative natural products containing 2-oxindole or HO-HPI moieties. (A) Structures of 2-oxindole- or HO-HPI-containing
alkaloids from organisms of varied kingdoms. (B) Structures of cyclohexapeptides with HO-HPI moieties. The 2-oxindole and HO-HPI structures
in this work are individually marked in blue and red. The HO-HPI structures of 9−11, 14, and 15 and the corresponding HO-HPI-forming P450
enzymes are highlighted with green. The residues different from those of 9 are marked with red circles in 10−11, 14, and 15.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. Enzymatical characterization of cpOPMOs (AfnD, HmtT, ClpD, KtzM, and LtzR). (A) Enzymatic assays of cpOPMOs using 12 as a
substrate. (B) AfnD assays were performed at different pH values. (C) AfnD catalyzed reaction that converts 12 to 9 and 13.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. Proposed catalytic mechanism of HmtT for the generation of HO-HPI and 2-oxindole structures. (A) Molecular docking model of HmtT
(colored white) with 12. Compound 12 is shown as a cyan stick and its 6-Cl-L-Trp residue is indicated in yellow. (B) View of the predicted
substrate-binding site of HmtT-pre-AFN A1 complex. The key residues (D73 and S75) are shown as green sticks. The heme group, atom oxygen,
and water molecule are shown as salmon sticks, red sticks, and red spheres, respectively. (C) Specific activities of HmtT and its mutants with the
substrate 12. Data represent the average of triplicate independent experiments (mean ± SD, n = 3). (D) Proposed catalytic mechanism of HmtT
converts 12 to 9 and 13.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 4. Point mutation analysis of the key residues of AfnD, ClpD, KtzM, and LtzR. (A) Views of the predicted substrate-binding sites of AfnD,
ClpD, KtzM, and LtzR with 12. The Asp and Ser/Thr residues around the predicted substrate-binding sites are shown as green sticks. Compound
12 is shown as a cyan stick and its 6-Cl-L-Trp residue is indicated in yellow. (B) Specific activities of AfnD, ClpD, KtzM, and LtzR and their
mutants with the substrate 12. Data represent the average of triplicate independent experiments (mean ± SD, n = 3).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 5. Substrate scope test of the cpOPMO mutants. The residues different from those of 12 are marked with red in compounds 16−22.
Reaction conditions of specific activities: 2 μM cpOPMO Asp or Ser/Thr mutants, 20 μM SelFdx1499, 10 μM SelFdR0978, 100 μM substrate, 1
mM NADH, 50 mM NaH2PO4−Na2HPO4 buffer (pH 7.0 or pH 6.0), 30 °C, 0.5 h. The yields of PHPI or POXI are displayed based on the substrate-
to-product ratio (%). The optimal catalyst for each product is shown here. Data represent the average of triplicate independent experiments (mean
± SD, n = 3).
